## 4.2.0 — connection pooling

The outbound HTTP client now shares one connection pool across every
integration. Pool exhaustion under burst load was the cause of the
timeout storms reported in issue 4471, and the per-integration clients
that preceded this change could not be bounded collectively.

Operators should expect a lower steady-state file-descriptor count and
a higher p99 on the first request after an idle period, which is the
cost of the shared idle-connection timeout.
